IDX auto-rejection bands.evidence: LC-PM-0009: R3 symmetric to 2025-04-07, R4 ARB -15% from 2025-04-08 (SK Kep-00003/BEI/04-2025). Dataset B: 58 R3 sessions, 328 R4 sessions.
IDX auto-rejection bands.meaning: regime-dependent daily price limits; the Dataset B window STRADDLES a boundary
IDX auto-rejection bands.research_use: each session carries a band_regime label. LC-PM-0009 states pooling across regimes without conditioning is void under B8.

bandar_detector.total_buyer / total_sell.evidence: disclosed_rows == min(total, 25) in 30,626/30,626 ticker-days on both sides, zero mismatches; parsed from the same API response as broker_flow yet reaching 79 where broker rows cap at 25; live probe at full limit returned exactly total_buyer / total_seller rows
bandar_detector.total_buyer / total_sell.meaning: UNCENSORED count of brokers net-buying / net-selling that ticker-session
bandar_detector.total_buyer / total_sell.research_use: the only uncensored participation measure available

bandar_detector.value / volume.evidence: value = volume*100*avg_price with standard deviation 0.0000 across 30,468 rows; live probe: bandar.volume equals the sum of positive net lots at ratio 1.0000
bandar_detector.value / volume.meaning: NET CROSSED volume and its rupiah value — NOT market traded totals
bandar_detector.value / volume.research_use: NEVER a denominator for concentration or market volume. Use ohlcv.volume for traded volume.

broker_flow.freq.evidence: the fetcher maps ONE vendor field onto both buy and sell rows (stockbit_fetcher.py:719,731). Tested against the independent stockbit_flow daily summary over 34,017 ticker-days: SUM(freq) / (flow.buy_freq+flow.sell_freq) has median 0.0080, and no variant reaches 2% agreement on any day. A ~100x shortfall is far beyond what top-25 truncation can explain (the top 25 carry ~75% of value).
broker_flow.freq.research_use: FORBIDDEN as a transaction count or ticket-size denominator until a vendor probe establishes its unit.

broker_flow.investor_type.evidence: 95 broker codes, exactly one investor_type each, invariant across 3,026,786 rows, 397 sessions, both sides, both calendar years. The third class has exactly four constant members (CC, NI, OD, DX). IDX investor reporting has two classes, not three.
broker_flow.investor_type.meaning: Ownership category of the BROKERAGE HOUSE: foreign-owned / local / government-state-owned brokerage
broker_flow.investor_type.research_use: say 'foreign-owned brokerage flow'. NEVER 'foreign investor flow', 'retail investor flow' or 'institutional investor flow'.

broker_flow.lot.evidence: a broker appears exactly once per ticker-session (3,026,786/3,026,786 rows have a single side); vendor request carries transaction_type=TRANSACTION_TYPE_NET; live probe at full limit nets to exactly 0
broker_flow.lot.meaning: NET lots for that broker on that ticker-session (buy minus sell), SIGNED
broker_flow.lot.research_use: SUM(lot) for a net. NEVER BUY_lot - SELL_lot (double-applies the sign).

broker_flow.lot_value.evidence: lot_value >= |lot|*100 in 3,026,786/3,026,786 rows; avg_price = value_total/lot_value in 3,015,371/3,026,786; the identity buy_gross + sell_gross - ohlcv_volume = bandar.volume*100 closes exactly on 74.8% of complete-disclosure days and within 1% on 87.0%
broker_flow.lot_value.meaning: GROSS shares transacted on the broker's dominant side; non-negative
broker_flow.lot_value.research_use: usable as gross-on-dominant-side. blotv/slotv field-level semantics are NOT independently confirmed against vendor documentation.

broker_flow.side.evidence: 757 BUY rows carry lot<0 and 1,822 SELL rows carry lot>0 in the Dataset A window — vendor rounding where net lots and net value disagree in sign
broker_flow.side.meaning: the sign of the broker's net, not a raw buy/sell split
broker_flow.side.research_use: derive direction from sign(value), never from the side column

broker_flow.value.evidence: SUM(value) = 0 on 70,424/70,424 complete-disclosure ticker-days; = 0 exactly on all three full-limit probe responses
broker_flow.value.meaning: NET rupiah value for that broker on that ticker-session, SIGNED
broker_flow.value.research_use: the accounting identity makes aggregate net UNINFORMATIVE. Do not resurrect aggregate net-flow as a directional variable.

broker_flow.value_total.meaning: GROSS rupiah on the broker's dominant side; non-negative

idx_tickers.in_idx80.evidence: matches no reconstitution period (best 64/80 at P2, 57/80 at P7); contains the 692nd most liquid stock on the exchange; no writer exists in the codebase, only readers
idx_tickers.in_idx80.meaning: a stale single snapshot written 2026-04-27; NOT historical membership
idx_tickers.in_idx80.research_use: FORBIDDEN. Use the frozen PIT roster artifact.

ohlcv.close / volume.evidence: already split-adjusted for PTRO, CUAN and DSSA; NOT adjusted for RAJA (close/broker-VWAP 4.946 before the ex-date, 0.993 after)
ohlcv.close / volume.meaning: traded price and volume, regular board; adjustment basis MIXED
ohlcv.close / volume.research_use: run the residual detector at build time; quarantine basis mismatches rather than applying a blanket adjustment (which would double-adjust the three already-correct tickers)
